book.name: Yonna Yesusmoa.
book.title: Yonna Yesusmoa. Yonmba Ishomnavna Yesusm, Sesoana Ombolm.

content: Yesusva Besal Kekalvhonindrini Sipsipnamba.
Yesusva os ona, tanam kava ishunv yemba, indhanariniva vongavavmoa tuvsharava sipsipna ninvhoramba, heva os himba vongavav mongnashara indanam, sna indhanariniva temba yukovnindrini.
Himba nomba diva tuvsharava sihavrava, temba himba nomba sipsipna kekalvhonindrini.

Wo indhanariniva nomba tuvpa kekalvho vrowovrava, hemba velaihamnavra tuvpa. Wo sipsippa hillimnivra moalamangmba no kekalvhonindrininamba. Himba wonewol vevra hevna sipsipmba, nihilm indakondakonda sevelunvra, wo os himba deisumbi lohmana vevra hemba.
Wo himba os wonphovrava, os wonlohmana vevra. Wo hev ku mi wulluhunvrava, os deisumbi lohmana vevra. Himba engingivra, manara, himba hillimniv kekalvhonindrinina moalamangmba.
Wo heva os himba mongomba indhanarinimba patvmonavavmoa. Himba pilialowolavav henaminiva, noinda himba hillimnivmoa hena moalamangmba.
Yesusva honi ishunna moamba indhanamba, wo heva os himba levrapivolnamoa honamba moamba temurava.
Wo henga Yesusva unna, kava ishunv yemba tanam. Ka tuvmsna sipsipnamba luhunv, ninvhomba.
Indkumbiva indhanamba temba miva doarava prowonamba, vevna, yukovnind, eva allambawonda. Wo sipsippa hilwilvnamoa hemba.
Ka tuvpa. Indhanariniva himba nomba kaindava sihavrava, hemba si lopshavav. Himba si beswonam vevra, sihavra, phovra, innemba silelalmba.
Yukovnindriniva prov, vev, yukov velm, eva indkokla vewolalm. Heva os kava prov, daswolalm undm, eva osm wohlundthoara undnangas.
Kava besal kekalvhonindrini. Besal kekalvhonindriniva hevmba wirehunv, daheinilm sipsipm.

Andranindrinimba, nomba temba diva dambroh velvohvpa, sipsip andrarava, temba indanapetam no kekalvhonindrinirava, hemba temba dahwol vevpa. Wo nomba andranindriniva nonglatava allambawondamba, osva ora, ten prov, himba dandwonam wohgavav, bumbrislahangavav sipsipmba di. Wo doa allambawondava os kelvhueindava, engalungu vevra, wo os sipsippa bukithengu vevra.
Indhanariniva dandwonam wohgana, noinda himba di andranindrini ambo. Himba undnahonamba andra vevnamoa, sipsipmba kekalvho vewolalmba.
Kava besal sipsipna kekalvhonindrini. Kava lihawol vev kavna sipsipmba, os ten ara kam lihavm. Wo eva kana sipsippa kamba kavmba liheivavta. Kava kavmba wirehunv, daheinilm kavna sipsipm.

Wo kanamba monglava sipsippa lovahv, heva os hona pueilmerava owai huiva. Wo kaoa hemoa wonproita eva. Himba si eva hillivrata kana moalamangmba, wo osva si lohvav, mongal sipsiptindiva, mongal kekalvhonindrini.
Aramba mindnam kamba und vev, noinda kava kavmba wirehunv, dahalm. Kava kavm wirehunv, dahalm, osm kava si hengava beswonam kavna nihnamba avav.

An eva kamba si helvakomandhavav? Kava yunalm kavmba wohwirehunv moahui. Kamba an eva ovomnavav owai, wo eva kava hengava kavna nihnamba avrava, an eva kamba ovomnavav? Honamba memba, aramba kamba os omnana velmba.
Henga Yutanindva owai, owalmongova mongawamomba eukvrivnamoa, noinda hona moa, snal Yesus ten ishovnam.
Indkumbiva himba os uvna, tihsongova doa sihamnana nihmera, wo noinda hemba daielmba ovomnav. Manara hilliv yimba hemba.
Heva os mongla uvna, indhanariniva nomba temba daiva venavpa tihsongonamba, osva ishovmoa sna moamba. Wo es hevpa tihsongova pevhoawol vinvrama novtitmungilna novmba?
Yutanindva Waialhuvna Yesusmba.
Wo doa innetihva mendekli phunvna Yerusalemrava. Nom seilminim henga nengvhueinam, lehalm deuvm, os memba Sesoana tempelduvnonoa. Memba nonam vivna, namvuvi hulvui iavnam.
Yesusva di lohmana vevna tempelmera Solomonna plasangsis.
Wo Yutanindva hemba kusomnanamba, hev umnina, eva mani om yimba phonama, kamba wera vewolalmba pevindava. Yimba tanamba Kristusva lohtava, wo eva os ishunuta musera kamoa.
Yesus ophona, kava ishunna yemba doa doara, wo heva os yimba kek vithinamoa. Osva kava memba mendekliandrava vevpa arana nihilla. Wo noi mendekliandra kamba museramba holvonethav, osva kava men.
Wo heva os yimba owai, mendah tit viv, manara noinda yimba kana sipsippa owai.
Kanamba sipsippa aong velvohv kana moalamangmba. Kava lihawol vev hemba, wo himba kamba wohengpetv.
Kava daswolv undva, yunalm nonapopolm wohalm, wo hemba si dalvramoa. Wo mongova indhanariniva hemba yukov vevavmoa kana englariniva.
Ara kana kamba holvorombraohna sipsipmba. Himba manana manana mendekli woheinv, wo an eva mongova yukov vevav kanamba sipsippa kana arana englariniva.
Kava araiva mongawundna mongal ahav.
Wo henga Yutanind hon di ovre, Yesusm nonam miklelm.
Wo heva os Yesus unna, kava doa vewol vena mendekliandrava besal aranaminiva. Wo heninda yimba kamba miklelmba viv?

Wo Yutanind opulvona, kava miklelmba vivmoa yemba, noindava memba besal andrava yimba venamba. Heva os ten pev ishomnavna sahonam Sesoam. Yimba ambo mongo indhanarininonoa, wo heva os yimba os oi, kava lohohra, os Sesoa ten avm.
Wo henga Yesus ophona, ten novol veluhunv pevna lohohmora, osva Sesoava os ona, yimba Sesoamsna av.
Honamba tombaimomba hemba os nengsmoa ov, yimba Sesoamsna av, indhanamba, henom Sesoava hevna moamba ishunna. Wo no tombaimomba gekalava ishovmoa.
Kava memba noi, Sesoa kamba pusvundthoana hevelm, wo wolaihaprana petharam. Wo manara yimba osva uvna, kava sahonam ishomnavna Sesoamba, noinda kava osva oi, kava Sesoana ombol?
Kava nomba owai vetava, temba aramba vevpa, wo osva manam yimba kamba keknamba amnavra undnahonamba.

Heva os kava vetava, osva temba aramba vevpa, eva yimba kamba keknamba amba owai venatava, nom ningvm, ten kav vewol vevm mendekliandramba. Wo yimba osva levrapivolvav, osva aramba kana nihra av, eva kava arana nihmera av.
Wo henga Yutanindva kevralm vivna Yesusmba, heva os himba hoai vinna henaminiva.
Wo doa Yesusva os gana, Yotan pom lovongo venamba, dom gavna, ten Yon Baptais nemet pona poswol vawonam. Yesusva di avna,
wo dom indhanamba esvemava provna heindamba. Hev una, Yonmba mendekliandrava osva vevnamoa. Heva os manam manam, Yonmba memba ishomnavnamba hona indhanarinimba, tanam.
Wo no kembellava mindnam lovahthapramnana keknamba undnahonamba Yesusmba.
